research_question: Can a gold-specific quantile-boosting adaptation with origin-observable realized moments and cross-market drivers produce stable selective 3-day and 5-day direction forecasts without forcing a signal?
relationship_to_v160: SEPARATE_SHORT_HORIZON_RESEARCH_LINE; does not reopen or repair the closed V1.51-V1.60 H20 sequence

literature_translation.method: quantile gradient boosting is used as a transparent sklearn implementation inspired by gold quantile-boosting papers; this is not claimed to reproduce the authors' exact algorithm
literature_translation.realized_moments: same-day realized volatility/skewness/downside/jump features are included only when observable at the 13:29 America/New_York research origin
literature_translation.model_instability: rolling estimation and monthly refit are fixed ex ante
literature_translation.selectivity: direction is emitted only when the estimated inter-quantile band lies wholly above or below zero

data.gold_endpoint: XAU/USD exact 13:29 America/New_York research cache bar
data.eligible_origin_rule: weekday origin with finite 13:29 close; horizon counts subsequent eligible origins
data.driver_binding: Federal Reserve Board H10 broad USD and H15 10Y inflation-indexed yield via V1.59R1 strict previous-date joins
data.futures_claim: NONE; this is an XAU spot adaptation of futures-oriented literature, not a COMEX settlement/futures replication

targets.return: log(close[t+h]/close[t]) over eligible weekday research origins
targets.direction: UP if return>0 else DOWN if return<0; zero-return rows are excluded from direction scoring

model.refit: first eligible origin of each calendar month; model is held fixed for the rest of that month
model.direction_rule: q25>0 => UP; q75<0 => DOWN; otherwise NO_SIGNAL
